svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank 110 x 70 mm from 2 mm sheet. Mark two fold lines 17 mm in from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: long edges and fold both flanges up 90 degrees in a bending brake.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Folded: web 40 mm across outside; flanges 18 mm tall from the underside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of the web (file the tops level if they come out taller).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Web: four 4.5 mm holes, 25 mm each side of the middle along the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bracket and 10 mm each side of the centre line across it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Band slots after folding: one through each flange, 14 x 3 mm, centred

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 45 mm each side of the middle, just above the web: drill 3 mm at each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end through the bend and file between. Deburr every edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rubber strips: 110 x 5 mm, 1.5 mm EPDM, glued along each flange top,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: overhanging the flange 2 mm inside and 1 mm outside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the arm rests on both strips, not on the metal.
